summary: Main per-frame game loop. Initializes the loop phase field *this to 5, then loops: runs ConditionalInit(&unk_8AFE18), and when SessionStateCheck(&dword_7CD25C) == 1 marks v2=1 and runs the body; otherwise reads the restart gate (v1 = RestartGate(&unk_7CE24D), v2 = byte_7CE254) and breaks out when v1 != 5. The body dispatches the conditional pipeline (ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher / ConditionalStateUpdate / TwoPathDispatch on dword_8AB6E4), updates the session manager (sub_463CA0, SessionScoringUpdate, CollisionResponseStatus on dword_7CD25C), resets buffers, runs the multi-phase state machine on dword_5EA2C0, broadcasts collision updates, ticks the main game (MainGameTickUpdate on unk_5EC6D0, IterateVehicles on dword_83EE60) and, depending on v2, either runs only WeatherParticleUpdate or the full camera/render/telemetry path (MainCameraDirectorUpdate, WeatherParticleUpdate, RenderScreenSave, ShortComputation_f070). Closes with ConditionalStateReset, RenderTickUpdate, sub_4FA7E0, sub_4FCEE0 and sub_4A1830; returns 0 when the session state is 1. After the loop, returns 0 for v1 == 4, logs "NextStateDWasN" for any other v1 != 6, and returns 1 otherwise. Called by GameMainEntry (0045B200).

operations.description: Initialize the loop phase/state counter: *this = 5.
Outer infinite while(1) loop whose exit is decided by the restart gate and the session-state check.
ConditionalInit(&unk_8AFE18) opens the per-frame conditional block.
When SessionStateCheck(&dword_7CD25C) == 1 set v2 = 1 and jump straight into the loop body.
v1 = RestartGate(&unk_7CE24D) and v2 = byte_7CE254; when v1 != 5 break out of the loop (post-loop exit handling follows).
ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher(&dword_8AB6E4) dispatches the conditional multi-path state.
sub_463CA0(&dword_7CD25C) updates the session manager.
ConditionalStateUpdate(&dword_8AB6E4) advances the conditional state.
BufferReset(&dword_7D2E50) clears the message buffer.
MultiPhaseProcessingStateMachine((int)dword_5EA2C0) runs the multi-phase simulation state machine.
sub_4D4580(&dword_8ACEE0) processes the module output list.
CollisionGlobalUpdateBroadcast(&ppvOut) broadcasts collision updates to module outputs.
MainGameTickUpdate(&unk_5EC6D0) ticks the main game state.
IterateVehicles(&dword_83EE60) iterates the active vehicle slots.
SessionScoringUpdate(&dword_7CD25C) updates session scoring.
CollisionResponseStatus(&dword_7CD25C) processes the collision response state.
TwoPathDispatch(&dword_8AB6E4) completes the conditional two-path dispatch.
BufferReset(&dword_83EE60) clears the vehicle iteration buffer.
Branch on v2: when set, run only WeatherParticleUpdate; otherwise run the full camera/render/telemetry path.
v2-set path: WeatherParticleUpdate(&dword_8ACEA0) updates weather particles only.
Full path: MainCameraDirectorUpdate((int)&dword_5EA510), WeatherParticleUpdate(&dword_8ACEA0), RenderScreenSave(&byte_8AB678) and ShortComputation_f070(&dword_7CE048).
ConditionalStateReset(&unk_8AFE18) closes the per-frame conditional block.
RenderTickUpdate(&byte_8AC494) advances the render tick state.
sub_4FA7E0(&unk_8AFE18) finalizes the conditional block context.
sub_4FCEE0(&unk_8AFEC0) updates the second conditional context.
sub_4A1830(&unk_7CE2A4) processes the session transition/phase context.
When SessionStateCheck(&dword_7CD25C) == 1 at the end of the body, return 0 immediately.
Post-loop exit: return 0 for v1 == 4; when v1 != 6, StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_11, 628) gates DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aNextStateDWasN); return 1.
Invoked by GameMainEntry (0045B200) as the main per-frame game loop.
